_about: Store listing for Equadeck. It's a web app today; this is ready for when it ships as an installable app (PWA wrapper on Google Play, or an iOS/macOS build). Checked by listing.py. avoid = the original's names (from brand.json).

app_store.name: Equadeck: LaTeX Equations
app_store.subtitle: Paste maths into your slides
app_store.promotional_text: New: Copy for Word. Paste an editable equation into Word or PowerPoint, not a picture. Free, no account.
app_store.description:
Equadeck turns LaTeX into crisp equations for your slides and documents.

Type LaTeX or tap symbols, watch the equation appear as you go, then paste it where you need it.

Made for slides and documents:
- Copy for Word and PowerPoint: pastes as an equation you can still edit
- Save as PNG (up to 4x), SVG or PDF, in dark ink even in dark mode
- See which LaTeX packages your equation needs, and copy it with them

Quick to write:
- Autocomplete for about 200 commands
- A symbol palette you can search
- Matrix builder, examples and reference sheets, including chemistry and physics notation

No strings:
- Free, with no account and no ads
- Save up to 50 equations on your device
- Nothing you type leaves your device
app_store.whats_new: Copy for Word: paste an editable equation into Word or PowerPoint.
